s1.syndrome_frame: Painless facial mass with deep tissue involvement and no systemic symptoms
salient_findings: Firm, mobile, non-tender mass in the left buccal space
Well-demarcated, hypoechoic solid mass on ultrasonography
Well-bordered, slightly enhancing soft-tissue tumor on CT
key_facts: 25-year-old woman presented with a painless lump in the left cheek
Lump was first noted nine months earlier
No toothache, numbness, or systemic symptoms
Left facial asymmetry without skin changes
Mass was approximately 4 cm in diameter
Located deep in the left buccal space and extending below the zygomatic arch
No cervical lymphadenopathy
Intraorally, a bulge of the left buccal mucosa
Fine-needle aspiration biopsy showed no signs of malignancy
Intraoral incisional biopsy demonstrated wide fibroblast proliferation

shortlist.label: Pleomorphic adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Most common benign salivary gland tumor, consistent with painless facial mass and deep tissue involvement

shortlist.label: Fibromatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Intraoral incisional biopsy demonstrated wide fibroblast proliferation, similar to fibroma, and fibromatosis is a type of fibrous tumor

shortlist.label: Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Benign tumor that can occur in the buccal space, although less likely given the deep tissue involvement and size of the mass

shortlist.label: Neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Benign nerve sheath tumor that can occur in the head and neck region, although less common in the buccal space

shortlist.label: Benign salivary gland tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Broad category that includes pleomorphic adenoma, and is consistent with the clinical presentation and biopsy results

raw.rationale: The presence of a painless, firm, and mobile mass in the buccal space, along with the imaging findings of a well-bordered, slightly enhancing soft-tissue tumor, and the biopsy results showing no signs of malignancy and wide fibroblast proliferation, are consistent with a pleomorphic adenoma, a common type of benign salivary gland tumor.

rejected.label: Fibromatosis
rejected.why: Fibromatosis is a more aggressive condition that typically presents with infiltrative growth and is less likely to be well-bordered on imaging.

rejected.label: Lipoma
rejected.why: Lipoma is a benign tumor composed of fat tissue, which is not suggested by the imaging or biopsy findings in this case.

rejected.label: Neurofibroma
rejected.why: Neurofibroma is a tumor of nerve tissue origin, which is not supported by the clinical or imaging features of this case.

rejected.label: Benign salivary gland tumor
rejected.why: While this is a broad category that includes pleomorphic adenoma, it is less specific and does not provide a distinct diagnosis.
